method: deterministic identity join on 21st.dev author+slug; new corpus id 'author__slug' normalized to lowercase 'author-slug' to match legacy flattened dir names
limitation: Identity join only. No content hashing, no AST/bundle comparison, no visual diff. Two records matching on author+slug are the same UPSTREAM component but may differ in local revision, since the two stores were harvested ~4 months apart (legacy 2026-04-22, new 2026-08-19).

name: 21st.dev corpus duplication: new bundle store vs legacy source store
rationale: The stores differ by ARTIFACT KIND, not just population. For the 2942 intersecting components the laptop holds BOTH real .tsx source (legacy) AND a compiled bundle + preview (new). Deduping by deleting either side would destroy capability. The 566 right-only components are source-bearing and absent from the newer corpus entirely.
recommended_join: Key on 21st.dev canonical URL (present in new meta.json as 'url', in legacy registry-item.json as _provenance.fetchedFrom). Produce one joined record per upstream component carrying: source_available(bool), bundle_available(bool), preview_available(bool), dependencies[], industry_tags[], usage_count.
evidence_refs: python identity join over os.listdir of both stores, 2026-08-27

name: Source-availability contradiction between the two 21st stores

claim_a.claim: Component source is not available. /r/<author>/<slug> is metered at 2/day on the free plan and component_data.code is empty even authenticated.
claim_a.label: direct

claim_b.claim: 3506 of 3507 component directories contain real .tsx implementation source
claim_b.label: direct

resolution: Both are true at their own observation times. The legacy store was populated 2026-04-22 via the metered per-component `get` path (registry/21st/README.md documents 'metered — 2/day on the free tier'); the newer corpus was built 2026-08-19 at 7,949 scale where that path is economically impossible. The constraint is RATE, not availability.
implication_for_foundry: Any block requiring readable source is bounded today by the 3506-component legacy set plus first-party code — NOT by the 7949 headline number. The headline count overstates block-eligible supply by ~2.3x for source-requiring block classes.

name: Design-system CATALOG/PROVENANCE reference paths do not exist
observed: none of these exist; actual content lives under library/{21st-dev,kokonutui,motion-primitives} with library/manifest.json
impact: CATALOG.md and PROVENANCE.md are the human-facing entry points for the curated bank and both point at a layout that has since been reorganized. An agent following the documented map finds nothing.

name: Industry taxonomy collision with the 17-industry denominator
tail_defect: Uncontrolled vocabulary — 'ai'/'ai-tools'/'ai-ml', 'creator-tools'/'creators-tools'/'creative-tools'/'creative', 'social'/'social-media' are unmerged synonyms; 26 of 36 values have <20 members and 1398 components carry the null-value tag 'other'.
verdict: NOT directly joinable to the 17-industry taxonomy without a controlled crosswalk
recommended_join: Author an explicit 36->17 crosswalk with an unmapped bucket; treat 'other' (1398) as unclassified, not as a 17th industry.

name: Two independent classification systems over the same upstream corpus

system_a.strength: tier 'page' is scraped ground truth from 21st's own tag pages

system_b.scheme: per-component classification.json: category, subcategory, visual_style, interactions, best_for_industries, platform_fit, complexity, use_cases
system_b.strength: carries industry + use-case semantics the 75-tag scheme lacks entirely

verdict: COMPLEMENTARY — merge, do not pick a winner
rationale: System A is authoritative on WHAT the component is (upstream taxonomy). System B is the only local source of WHO it is for (industry) and WHAT JOB it does (use_cases). The foundry's retrieval layer needs both axes.
caveat: System A's 'local' tier (2636 components, 33%) is self-declared weakest — slug/name/description string matching. Do not treat tier-local tags as capability evidence.

name: Prior laptop-estate inventory vs this lane
prior_scope: 8 units, whole-estate disposition (keep/extract/vault/move), stage=candidate for siso-ui-base
this_lane_scope: foundry-specific asset join with measured counts, integrity-gate results, and cross-store dedupe
relationship: THIS LANE SUPERSEDES NOTHING. It refines one prior unit (siso-ui-base-candidate) with measured evidence and corrects its stale paths.
prior_blockers_still_standing: No accepted SISO UI Base Work exists in V37.
Local project presence does not establish ownership, rights, or release readiness.
assessment: Both prior blockers remain UNRESOLVED as of 2026-08-27. Nothing in this lane's evidence discharges either. Confidence on the unit should stay 'low' and portability 'requires_sanitization'.

name: Rights-record absence is uniform across every third-party store
verdict: No third-party local asset carries a machine-checkable rights record.
note: Counts records, not distinct upstream works; the two 21st stores overlap by 2942.
